title: wolfHSM C_Login: server connection and whClientContext lifecycle
description:
Implement the C_Login path for WP11_PROTO_WOLFHSM slots.

What needs to be done:
- When C_Login is called on a wolfHSM slot, allocate and connect a whClientContext using the transport configured for the slot (initially SHM for loopback; TCP for networked deployments)
- Store the connected context in g_slots[slot_id].client
- On success, mark slot as logged in (slot_login=1, all sessions updated)
- On C_Logout or C_Finalize, call wh_Client_Cleanup() and free/zero the context

Transport configuration:
- SHM transport: server ID from env WOLFP11_HSM_SHM_ID (for local testing)
- TCP transport: host:port from env WOLFP11_HSM_TCP_ADDR (for networked HSM)
- Default to SHM if only SHM env var is set; TCP if only TCP; error if neither

Error mapping:
- Connection refused / timeout → CKR_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND
- Auth failure → CKR_PIN_INCORRECT
- Any wh_Client_Init failure → CKR_DEVICE_ERROR
